[P2] Add the required public-type consumer example

These declarations change the contract for consumers with `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`: explicit `undefined` becomes accepted, and checking property presence no longer guarantees a defined value. Root `AGENTS.md` Tests rule 3 requires an example for public API changes, but this diff adds none, and existing examples compile without the flag. The reported generic compiler probe does not validate the changed SDK declarations. Add an examples-package consumer fixture compiled with the flag enabled that demonstrates explicit undefined values and safe narrowing of the affected public fields.
